claims: As of late March 2026, U.S. mortgage rates have risen.
As of late March 2026, the 30-year fixed average U.S. mortgage rate is hovering between 6.4% and 6.6%.
As of late March 2026, the 30-year fixed average U.S. mortgage rate has reached levels not seen since late 2025.
As of late March 2026, rates for U.S. 15-year mortgage loans are generally in the high 5% range.
As of late March 2026, the U.S. 30-Year Fixed mortgage rate is roughly 6.43%–6.55%.
As of late March 2026, the U.S. 15-Year Fixed mortgage rate is roughly 5.6%–5.8%.
As of late March 2026, the U.S. 5/1 ARM mortgage rate is roughly 5.75%.
In March 2026, mortgage rates have recently surged.
In March 2026, mortgage rates have reversed earlier year-to-date declines.
In mid-March 2026, active inventory has increased ~5.6% year-over-year.
As of March 2026, home prices remain flat.
